discovery_notes: Cell B333, follow-up 4 of B015 (packets 215, 422, 464, 496); reuses their keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only; most values come from search-engine summaries of the pages, not quoted page text. New: HKDL 13th anniversary phase 2 five named LE pins (Chip, Duffy, ShellieMay, Gelatoni, StellaLou); Pin Trading Carnival 2018 treasure jumbo, ambassador and Magic Access pins plus three member sets (six-pin box, designer series, 12 food-truck HMs) unnamed; HKDL summer 2018 events (PIN-GO, Pin Trading Nights, Magical Moment) as sets only; SHDR Nov 2018 Hidden Mickey Judy Hopps; TDS Easter 2018 egg pin and five Abu's Bazaar Easter prize pins. No holds released. Resellers (carousell, usshoppingsos, belloshophk, parkscollectibles) and YouTube ignored.
